tags.description: Used to filter and group towers in the library view.

root.description: Base directory for every relative path. Defaults to the tower file directory.

budget.description: Whole run / session of the system, across every node.

usd.description: Amount in US dollars (shorthand for amount + currency USD).

per.description: What the budget is counted over. Default: one run of this node.

for.description: What it pays for when several budgets apply: model, media, ads, api...

rate.description: Unit price, e.g. "0.40 USD/s of video" or "1.20 EUR/take".

rate.description: Unit price, e.g. "0.40 USD/s of video" or "1.20 EUR/take".

limits.description: Whole run / session of the system, across every node.

ttl.description: Lifetime of a session / sandbox / browser.

max_iterations.description: Bound for loops (review rounds, tournament rounds...).

rate.description: Quotas and rate limits, e.g. "100/24h" posts or ["300/5m", "15000/d"] requests.

provider.description: aws, gcp, hetzner, anthropic, vercel, github-actions...

meta.description: Free-form key/value metadata shown in the inspector.

file.description: Path to the prompt file, relative to `root`.

vars.description: Template variables. Auto-detected from {{var}} when omitted.

from.description: Import a Claude Code style agent file (.md with YAML frontmatter). Explicit fields override it.

file.description: Path to the prompt file, relative to `root`.

vars.description: Template variables. Auto-detected from {{var}} when omitted.

harness.description: Runtime settings: max_turns, temperature, permission_mode, budget...

tower.description: Path to a nested .tower.yaml describing this agent internals.

runtime.description: Reference to an entry of the `runtimes` registry.

path.description: Local file, opens in the viewer (logs show their tail).

url.description: External link, opens in a new tab.

disabled_tools.description: Built-in tools turned off for this agent.

trigger.description: What starts this node (entry nodes, scheduled agents).

source.description: Who fires it: PagerDuty, Gmail, a queue name, a Slack channel...

timezone.description: IANA zone the schedule and hours are in, e.g. "Europe/Rome".

hours.description: When it may fire, e.g. "Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00" or "business days".

actions.description: `takeover`: a human takes the session over (live view) while automation pauses.

escalate_to.description: Backup approver when it times out or is escalated.

via.description: Slack, email, PR review, app... several channels as a list.

relayed_by.description: Agent that carries the request to the human and the answer back.

when.description: Condition that requires it, e.g. "refund > 500 EUR" or "discount > 10%". Without it: always.

per.description: Asked per item instead of once, e.g. "flag", "row", "invoice".

rounds.description: Revision rounds included before it must be approved or rejected.

ttl.description: Lifetime of a session / sandbox / browser.

max_iterations.description: Bound for loops (review rounds, tournament rounds...).

rate.description: Quotas and rate limits, e.g. "100/24h" posts or ["300/5m", "15000/d"] requests.

by.description: What decides the count; several dimensions multiply (store × locale × device).

from.description: Different agents the copies are picked from (a supervisor queue), by agent id.

pick.description: How they are picked, e.g. "weighted by queue priority".

data.description: Sensitivity and residency of the data handled here.

region.description: Where data must stay (eu, us, eu-west-1...).

retention.description: How long it is kept; `none` = in memory only, never persisted.

retention_after.description: Event the retention runs from, e.g. "matter close" (default: creation).

lawful_basis.description: GDPR basis for processing personal data.

disclosure.description: Labels and provenance on what it publishes: "C2PA", "AI-generated label", "EU AI Act art. 50"...

higher_is_better.description: Defaults to true. Used to color value vs target.

unit.description: "%", "ms", "Elo", "USD"... Relative scores (Elo, rank) need no target.

illustrative.description: True when the number is an example, not a measurement.

metric.description: What decides promotion, e.g. "approval rate" or "crash-free sessions".

guard.description: Halt or roll back when, e.g. "crash-free < 99.5%".

sample.description: Sample size per step or arm.

sla.description: Deadline to complete: "72h", or { within, after, before, by, business, external }.

after.description: Event it runs from, e.g. "SDI rejection" or "store submission".

before.description: Event it must end before, e.g. "release".

business.description: Counted in business days / hours (see trigger hours and timezone).

external.description: An external wait (store review, carrier, regulator), not our processing time.

async.description: Result comes back later: poll or callback.

exactly_once.description: Must run at most once per item (payouts, filings): idempotency key, no retries that repeat it.

decision.description: Typed output of a decision (decision models).

confidence.description: Returns a probability / confidence with the answer.

model.description: Pinned decision model or policy version.

fail.description: On error or low confidence: let it through (open) or block (closed).

credentials.description: Whose credentials the tools use: a service account, the author, or the end user.
